name: bun-gridfs-storage
description: A Multer storage engine for GridFS that works with both Bun and Node.js

scripts.build: bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm && bun run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target node --format cjs --external mongoose --external mongodb --external multer --external express
scripts.build:esm: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.mjs --target node --format esm --external mongoose --external mongodb --external multer --external express

author: Aissam Irhir <aissamirhir@gmail.com>
